must_identify.item: The api exits because it cannot resolve redis-master
REDIS_HOST is set to redis-master while the Service is named redis

notes: The RCA reports only the symptom: the pod is not ready, so the Service has no endpoints. It attributes this to failing health checks or the readiness probe, and never mentions redis, DNS resolution or the REDIS_HOST change. The generic fix (check logs, fix the readiness probe, restart) would not restore REDIS_HOST=redis or roll back the deploy.
